verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation saying macOS supports the latest IDEs, developer toolchains, or AI/ML software as a primary platform. The docs cover Continuity, Siri AI, Safari and the Passwords app. Community threads mention Xcode builds hanging and slow `go build` runs on Catalina, but these are incidental performance complaints, not evidence that macOS delivers this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use the latest IDEs, toolchains, and AI/ML software on a primary supported platform
